title: Where is the Mathematics mark of the fourth student?
description: A marks sheet names every box by a column letter and a row number. The video finds one box and names a line of six boxes. Keeko puts the row number first and is corrected.
teaching_notes: One idea: a cell name is the column letter first and then the row number, and a range joins the first cell and the last cell. Watch for students who write the row number first.

source: Find the cell of Farooq's Mathematics marks and describe Nagesh's marks as a range.
video_script.why: A child who has read tables now names a box of a spreadsheet by its column letter and row number, and names a line of boxes.
video_script.substitution: the book's marks sheet: Farooq in row 5, Mathematics in column E (42); Nagesh in row 3, marks in columns B to G
video_script.anchor: the class marks sheet with names down the left and subjects across the top
video_script.wrong_answer: the range is three B to three G
video_script.wrong_move: puts the row number before the column letter, so 3B:3G is written; a cell name starts with the column letter
video_script.payoff_line: E five holds forty two, and the six marks are in B three to G three

final_answer.value: E5 holds 42; Nagesh's marks are B3:G3
final_answer.spoken: E five holds forty two, and the six marks are in B three to G three

names.Laksh: class teacher who keeps the marks of the class

maths_rules: cell name = column letter then row number
row 1 holds the headings; the students begin in row 2: Ratna row 2, Nagesh row 3, Ashwin row 4, Farooq row 5
columns: A Name, B Odia, C Telugu, D English, E Mathematics, F Social Science, G Science
Farooq: row 5, Mathematics column E, so the cell is E5 and it holds 42
Nagesh: row 3, six marks in columns B, C, D, E, F, G, so the range is B3:G3
ground example: D4 is column D, row 4; B4:D4 is a line of three cells in row 4
slip: 3B:3G puts the row number first and is not a range
video_script.design: One marks sheet all video. The row is found, then the column, then the box where they meet is lit. Keeko writes the row number first and the bubble is struck out.

<bookmark mark='ask'/>Which box holds the Mathematics marks of the fourth student? How can we name the six marks of the second student?

narration: <bookmark mark='cell'/>Each box in a spreadsheet is called a cell.
<bookmark mark='name'/>A cell is named by its column letter and then its row number.
<bookmark mark='eg'/>The cell D four lies in column D and in row four.
<bookmark mark='range'/>The cells from B four to D four form a line. Such a line is called a range.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the range is three B to three G.
<bookmark mark='move'/>Keeko wrote the row number before the column letter.
<bookmark mark='why'/>But a cell name always starts with the column letter, as in D four.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>The column letter comes first, so the marks are in B three to G three.
